patch_description: Replace greedy+local-search with a λ-feasibility binary search: for candidate max-KVPR λ, pack models via first-fit with constraint load_i + w ≤ λ·free_i. Feasibility is monotone in λ, so binary search finds the minimum λ. Run over four candidate orderings (density, size, w, s+w desc) and keep the best feasible placement.
